intent: Resolve the ninety evidence records carrying licence unknown, which violates item 11 of packs/PACK_SHAPE.md. They are mostly arXiv preprints, twenty-five of them, and vendor documentation, where the licence is per submission or per site and has to be read off the page. Either record the real licence at a fresh access date, or replace unknown with a stated reason class so the gap is governed rather than silent. Do not infer a licence from the domain. Counted by kind: thirty-six maintainer, twenty-nine controlled, thirteen standard, twelve exemplar.
